question: Related Questions Q. In one fatwa,a person asked from u:Is it jayaz for man to meet his wife before marriage or a man and woman can meet each other before marriage and select each other only after seeing each other? U replied :A man and woman, before nikah, are like strangers; they can not see and meet each other. It is not right to see the girl you want to marry by appointing a meeting; it is allowable only if you see her by chance. It is better to get a proposed girl seen by ones relative women. In another fatwa a person asked:Assalamalaikum I have come to know that it is not permissible to even look at 'ghair-mahram', i.e., someone who you are eligible to marry with. If this is true, then how can a person - male or female - decide his/her future spouse? U replied:It is prohibited to look at ghar-mahram, (strange opposite sex) but if you intend to marry a girl then you can see her once, rather it has been declared allowed in a hadith. answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 35855 Country: India Title: Can a person not marry from other than his relatives, is it mandatory for a Muslim man to marry amongst his own relatives and how far is it justified Question: Can a person not marry from other than his relatives, is it mandatory for a Muslim man to marry amongst his own relatives and how far is it justified? Answer ID: 35855 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 93/93/M=1433) According to Shariah, it is not mandatory and wajib to marry one's relatives. One can marry other than one's relatives. A man is free to marry where he wishes. It is better to marry to one’s suitable match. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
